BackstoryDef.title: Winterhold urchin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in Winterhold, in the shadow of the College bridge. [PAWN_pronoun] carried firewood up to the mages for a few coins and one day set a pile of it alight without touching it.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea of Ghosts fisher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fished the Sea of Ghosts with [PAWN_possessive] family until the ice that froze around the boat started answering [PAWN_possessive] temper. The village sent [PAWN_objective] north to the College before [PAWN_pronoun] sank someone.

BackstoryDef.title: tutored noble
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a jarl's court by a hired court wizard who taught [PAWN_objective] letters, history and a few cantrips. [PAWN_pronoun] was the only one in the family who paid attention to the cantrips.

BackstoryDef.title: College apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] crossed the bridge to the College and passed the entrance test on the first try. [PAWN_pronoun] spends most days in lectures and the rest in the Arcanaeum, trying not to annoy the librarian.

BackstoryDef.title: College adept
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a room in the Hall of Attainment and a specialty [PAWN_pronoun] is still deciding on. [PAWN_pronoun] tutors new apprentices for extra coin and studies Alteration late into the night.

BackstoryDef.title: College conjurer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studies Conjuration and keeps a familiar that follows [PAWN_objective] around the halls. The other mages wish [PAWN_pronoun] would stop summoning it indoors.

BackstoryDef.title: College battlemage
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned Destruction at the College and took it into the field, hiring out to jarls and caravans. [PAWN_pronoun] came back to Winterhold with burn scars and a lot of practical opinions about ward spells.

BackstoryDef.title: College enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works at the arcane enchanter in the Hall of Countenance, binding soul gems to anything that holds still. Half of the College's gold comes from selling [PAWN_possessive] work in Whiterun and Solitude.

BackstoryDef.title: Arcanaeum scribe
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] copies and repairs the College's older books, some of them older than the Empire. [PAWN_pronoun] knows where every volume is shelved and will tell you, if you return the last one you borrowed.
